description: Start on an inline catalog card with information focused. Read-only navigation; never activate Watchlist or playback.

steps.name: 01-catalog-ratings
steps.review: Provider ratings use library presentation; omit absent providers. Trailer only appears when Plex supplies a supported trailer. Open in Library requires an exact local match.

steps.name: 02-catalog-buttons
steps.review: Button focus, ratings, summary and Back hint fit without overlap. Explicit trailer playback is a separate authorized device check.

steps.name: 03-catalog-full
steps.review: Information target opens full details with provided synopsis, ratings, genres and cast; optional missing fields are omitted.

steps.name: 04-catalog-back-inline
steps.review: Back returns to same inline card with information focused.

steps.name: 05-catalog-back-search
steps.review: Second Back restores original result row, position and focus without requesting or playing anything.
